title: 第9章 三个时辰的奇迹第10章 小师叔的排场
slug: 满级雷灵根卷哭修仙界
lines: 栖凤峰的修炼室内，凤临渊正在教导林枝意引气入体的法门。
他原本已经做好了长期指导的准备，毕竟再天才的修士，引气入体也需要数日甚至数月时间。
“闭上眼睛，感受天地间的灵气。”凤临渊的声音平和，
“将意念沉入丹田，想象自己是一块海绵，在吸收周围的水分。”
林枝意盘腿坐在蒲团上，小脸严肃，依言闭上眼睛。
凤临渊站在一旁，仔细观察着这个小徒弟的灵根特性。
然而接下来发生的事情，让他这个见多识广的“飞升老祖关门弟子”也感到惊讶。
只见林枝意周身开始汇聚起淡淡的紫色光点。
那是雷灵根在吸引天地间的雷属性灵气。
但与此同时，一些灰黑色的气流也不断从四面八方涌来，那是
“阴暗力量？”凤临渊微微蹙眉。
更让他惊讶的是，这些阴暗力量在靠近林枝意身体后，并没有像寻常修士那样被排斥或侵蚀经脉，反而被雷灵根的力量包裹、转化，最终变成了精纯的灵气，融入她的丹田。
“阴灵根与雷灵根融合后，竟然能转化阴暗力量为灵力？”凤临渊眼中闪过惊奇之色，
“几个老头真是捡了芝麻丢了西瓜啊，也不知道他们发什么神经，和着魔了一样非要那个水灵根，还不要这个天灵根。”
他仔细观察着这个过程，发现林枝意体内的两种灵根已经完美融合，形成了一个独特的循环系统。
雷灵根至阳至刚，阴灵根至阴至柔，二者相生相克，反而达到了某种平衡。
“有意思，太有意思了。”凤临渊唇角勾起一抹玩味的笑容。
三个时辰后，当夕阳的余晖透过窗棂洒进修炼室时，林枝意周身突然爆发出一阵强烈的灵力波动。
空气中的灵气疯狂地向她涌去，在她头顶形成一个肉眼可见的小型旋涡。
凤临渊眼中精光一闪“成了。”
林枝意睁开眼睛，小脸上满是兴奋“师虎！意意感觉到肚子里有只小蝴蝶在飞！”
那是灵气在丹田内凝聚的征兆。
凤临渊难得地露出赞许的笑容“做得很好。”
他表面平静，内心却掀起了惊涛骇浪。
三个时辰引气入体，这在整个修仙界的历史上都闻所未闻！
当晚，玄天剑派各峰都出现了一个红色的身影。
“师侄，这么晚还在教导弟子啊？”
凤临渊悠闲地踱步到寒冰峰，对着正在指导李寒风的长老打招呼。
长老抬头，有些诧异“凤师叔？什么风把您吹来了？”
凤临渊摆摆手，状似随意地说“没什么，就是路过。哎呀，你怎么知道我的宝贝小徒弟三个时辰就成功引气入体了？”
李长老“？”他还没问啊？
“哎呀，天赋一般啦，也没那么厉害～”
凤临渊继续“谦虚”地说着，脸上的得意却掩饰不住，“就是随便教教，没想到这么快就会了。”
长老嘴角抽搐，看着眼前这个明明很得意却偏要装模作样的师叔，一时不知该说什么好。
同样的一幕接连在各峰上演。
content_en:
In the training room at Qifeng Peak, Feng Linyuan was teaching Lin Zhiyi how to draw Qi into the body.
He had already prepared for long-term guidance. After all, even the most talented monk would need days or even months to introduce Qi into his body.
"Close your eyes and feel the aura between heaven and earth." Feng Linyuan's voice was calm.
"Sink your mind into your Dantian and imagine that you are a sponge, absorbing the moisture around you."
Lin Zhiyi sat cross-legged on the futon with a serious face and closed her eyes as instructed.
Feng Linyuan stood aside and carefully observed the characteristics of this young apprentice's spiritual roots.
However, what happened next surprised him, a well-informed "disciple of the ascended ancestor".
I saw faint purple light spots starting to gather around Lin Zhiyi's body.
That is the thunder spirit root attracting the thunder attribute spiritual energy between heaven and earth.
But at the same time, some gray-black airflows continued to come from all directions, that was
"Dark power?" Feng Linyuan frowned slightly.
What surprised him even more was that after these dark forces approached Lin Zhiyi's body, they were not rejected or eroded through the meridians like ordinary monks. Instead, they were wrapped and transformed by the power of Lei Linggen, and finally turned into pure spiritual energy and integrated into her Dantian.
"After the fusion of Yin Spirit Root and Thunder Spirit Root, it can actually transform dark power into spiritual power?" Feng Linyuan's eyes flashed with surprise,
"These old men really picked up the sesame seeds and lost the watermelon. I don't know what's wrong with them. They are as if they are possessed by a demon and they insist on the water spirit root and don't want the heaven spirit root."
He carefully observed this process and found that the two spiritual roots in Lin Zhiyi's body had been perfectly integrated to form a unique circulation system.
The thunder spirit root is yang and strong, and the yin spirit root is yin and soft. The two complement each other and reach a certain balance.
"Interesting, so interesting." Feng Linyuan's lips curved into a playful smile.
Three hours later, when the afterglow of the setting sun shone into the training room through the window lattice, Lin Zhiyi's whole body suddenly erupted with a strong wave of spiritual power.
The spiritual energy in the air rushed toward her crazily, forming a small vortex above her head that was visible to the naked eye.
Feng Linyuan's eyes flashed, "It's done."
Lin Zhiyi opened her eyes, her little face full of excitement, "Shihu! Yiyi feels a little butterfly flying in her stomach!"
That is a sign that spiritual energy is condensing in the Dantian.
Feng Linyuan showed a rare smile of approval, "Well done."
He was calm on the surface, but there was a turmoil in his heart.
Introducing Qi into the body for three hours is unheard of in the entire history of the world of immortality!
That night, a red figure appeared on each peak of the Xuantian Sword Sect.
"Master nephew, are you still teaching your disciples so late at night?"
Feng Linyuan walked leisurely to the Ice Peak and greeted the elder who was instructing Li Hanfeng.
The elder looked up and was a little surprised, "Uncle Feng? What kind of wind brought you here?"
Feng Linyuan waved his hand and said casually, "Nothing, just passing by. Oh, how did you know that my precious little apprentice successfully introduced Qi into his body in three hours?"
Elder Li "?" He hasn't asked yet?
"Oh, my talent is average, not that great~"
Feng Linyuan continued to speak "humbly", but could not hide the pride on his face, "I just taught you casually, I didn't expect to master it so soon."
The corner of the elder's mouth twitched, and he didn't know what to say when he looked at the uncle in front of him who was obviously very proud but still pretending.
The same scene happened one after another on every peak.
